thread:
maya: prod embeddings service showing 503 spikes starting 08:12. Root cause looks like the recent worker-image bump increased memory pressure in eu-west. Can we expedite a pin + queue-tuning hotfix? I will open a PR and request deploybot run. @ops-oncall please review.

deploybot: deploy request created: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 (embed-queue-tune). Proposed rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 30% -> 100%. Requires 2 approvals OR explicit @ops-oncall signoff to accelerate.

igor: what's the rollback plan? if the new image regresses we should revert to `image:sha-abc123` and ensure replicas scale back. any DB or schema work?

maya: rollback plan: revert image to `sha-abc123` and scale replicas back to 12. no DB migrations. Revert commands: ```deploybot rollback --service embeddings --to-image sha-abc123``` or `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=sha-abc123 -n prod`. Smoke checks: /health 200, tail logs show no OOMs, token queue length stable.

sam: quick note — skipping canary entirely feels risky. Proposal: start at 1% and allow @ops-oncall or one eng lead to accelerate after a 5m green window. If ops signs off we can jump directly to 30%. I can +1 once smoke looks clean.

liz: +1. I'll add a short release note entry: "hotfix: embed worker pin + queue tuning — mitigates 503 spikes" and a link to PR.

ops-oncall: I can approve expedited if 1% smoke passes and 5xx drops. Keep me posted; I'll run the synthetic checks and tail the Pod logs once canary starts.

deploybot: canary started: 1% traffic (approx 30 instances). Status: 1% deploy in progress.

maya: smoke looks good from prod-ops side, no new OOMs in the patched pods, 5xx rate down ~85% on canary slice.

igor: dashboards show reduced error rate and stable latency. +1 to accelerate to 30% but recommend 5m observation between steps.

deploybot: promoted from 1% -> 5%. Status: 5% deploy succeeded (0 errors).

sam: pushing next? ops?

ops-oncall: go for 30% now. We'll hold at 30% for 10m and watch errors/latency. Rollback if 5xx > 2x baseline or pod OOMs.

deploybot: promoted from 5% -> 30%. Status: 30% successful.

maya: logs look clean. request moving to 100% to fully mitigate customer impact.

igor: agree but leave ops to hit final GO.

ops-oncall: approving full rollout. I'll keep monitoring for 15m; will call rollback if triggers fire.

deploybot: promoted from 30% -> 100%. Deploy completed at 1755560198.

maya: thanks all — incident mitigated. Short release note posted: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/4823 and PR linked. :tada: If anything regresses, I'll reopen the thread.
